title: Collocate provider credentials and perform surgical Terraform module splits
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce coupling between Terraform provider credentials and high-level environment overlays, shrink module surface area to make state migrations surgical, and upgrade the AWS provider to a single target version across top-level workspaces. This ticket covers design, targeted module splits (network primitives, egress policies, NAT/EIP lifecycle), credential lookup consolidation, and a zero-downtime plan for migrating a handful of non-critical workspaces. Expected outcomes: fewer provider overrides in overlays, clearer module boundaries to enable safer provider bumps, and a documented migration runbook.
updates: 2026-02-18 - Triage: Identified repeated incidents where provider version skew and per-workspace credential blocks caused drift. Decision: pursue a targeted module-splitting approach rather than a big-bang rewrite to limit migration blast radius.

2026-02-22 - Design review: Proposed moving credential sources into a single 'credentials' module consumed by environment overlays via data lookups. Agreed to keep provider aliasing only for cross-account egress until cross-account roles are finalized.

2026-03-01 - Spike complete: Proof-of-concept split for subnet/nat/eip into a small "network-primitives" module. Verified plan preserves existing remote state layout and reduces duplicated provider blocks by ~60% in a sample workspace (staging-us-west-2). Notes and diffs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFRA/ENG-45321+design-spike

2026-03-04 - Implementation started: Opened draft PR for credentials collocation and module split: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/7821. Approach: introduce credentials module, update top-level env overlays to reference data.external_provider_creds, leave provider version pinned at 5.x for now with compatibility shim.

2026-03-07 - CI & plan outputs: Ran dry-run in sandbox workspace, plan shows only metadata moves and no resource recreation for targeted workspaces. Added feature flag 'enable_surgical_split' to gate rollout.

2026-03-10 - Security signoff pending: Generated list of KMS/role changes for credential retrieval; security requested a short runbook for key rotation and audit logging before enabling in production. Assigned to Security: Evelyn Turner.

2026-03-12 - Testing: Deployed to canary workspace (canary-eu-west-1). Observed ephemeral AWS provider warnings related to mixed provider version constraints in a downstream module. Action: add compatibility shim and a follow-up ticket to remove legacy module in Q2.

2026-03-14 - ETA update: Addressed CI flake and updated PR with provider-compat module. Rolling window for production migration proposed: weekend maintenance window with staged workspace promotion and immediate rollback plan. Next: obtain final security approval and schedule migration window.
